name: PosterView
description: Self-hosted artwork manager for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. Browse libraries, including collections, and replace posters, backgrounds, and logos from multiple artwork providers.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: SQLite database, encryption key, settings, apply history, and persistent artwork caches

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the PosterView web UI

variables.name: Require Login
variables.description: false disables login for ALL connections, including reverse proxies and remote access. true requires administrator login unless local-network bypass is enabled in Settings. Defaults to false. Use only on a trusted network when disabled.

variables.name: Administrator Username
variables.description: Username when Require Login is true. Defaults to admin.

variables.name: Administrator Password
variables.description: Password for the PosterView sign-in screen. Leave blank to generate one in /data/admin-password.txt.
